answer.chapter_title: Money: Bharose se bank balance tak
answer.big_question: Ek kagaz, coin ya screen par number ko paisa kaun banata hai, aur yeh poori economy ko kaise chalata hai?

pillars.title: Paisa kyun aur kaise bana?
pillars.line: Barter ki rukawaton se gold-backed notes tak, har naya roop exchange ki ek dikkat suljhata hai.

pillars.title: Paise ko value aur kanooni taqat kahan se milti hai?
pillars.line: Fiat money, legal tender, dollar aur rupee ki kahani mein bharose aur authority ka role dekho.

pillars.title: Note ka bharosa kaise bachta ya toot-ta hai?
pillars.line: Tughlaq ke experiment se security features, demonetisation aur Gresham's Law tak.

pillars.title: Account se payment tak paisa kaise pahunchta hai?
pillars.line: Bank instruments, UPI aur payment networks ke andar paisa aur instructions ka raasta dekho.

pillars.title: Naya paisa kya hai, aur total paisa kaise ginte hain?
pillars.line: Polymer, crypto aur RBI ke money aggregates ko alag-alag pehchaano.

questions.question: Dukaan par cash bhi chalta hai aur account ka balance bhi—dono paisa kaise hain?
questions.hook: Wallet khaali hai, phir bhi groceries ki payment ho jaati hai.

points.point: Goods-services khareedne aur karz chukane ke liye accept hone wali cheez money hai.
Money sirf notes-coins nahi; accepted bank deposits aur digital balances bhi payment mein kaam aate hain.
Achha paisa log accept karein, jaldi kharab na ho aur aasani se carry ho sake.
Achhe paise ki chhoti units ban sakein, same denomination ki units uniform hon aur supply ki scarcity value sambhalne mein madad kare.
Money exchange ka medium aur common price scale hai—₹500 se groceries milti hain aur ₹20,000 ka phone ₹60,000 ke laptop se compare hota hai.
Money purchasing power future ke liye rakhne aur loan-EMI jaise future payments fix karne ka kaam karta hai.

film.showing_moment: Ek hi ₹500 ki value shopping, price tag, savings aur future payment ke chaar use-slots mein dikhai deti hai.

game_stage.idea: Payment, price comparison, saving aur EMI ke scenes ko sahi money-function par rakho; sahi match se transaction complete ho.

questions.question: Mere paas gehun hai aur mujhe jootey chahiye—sauda atak kyun sakta hai?
questions.hook: Mochi ko gehun nahi, doodh chahiye; tumhara gehun kaam ka hote hue bhi payment nahi ban raha.

points.point: Barter mein money ke bina goods-services seedhe exchange hote hain aur value aapas ki agreement se tay hoti hai.
Barter early civilizations mein common tha aur aaj bhi kuch informal exchanges mein milta hai.
Double coincidence of wants mein dono parties ko ek-doosre ki offered cheez ek hi waqt par chahiye hoti hai.
Common value scale aur divisibility na hone se barter mein price compare karna aur chhota payment karna mushkil hota hai.
Goods mein wealth store karna aur future payment ka standard fix karna bhi mushkil hota hai.

film.showing_moment: Gehun se jootey lene ki exchange line mochi ki alag demand par ruk jaati hai.

game_stage.idea: Logon ki wants dekhkar barter ka route banao; matching wants na milne par goods ki movement ruk jaaye.

questions.question: Agar sab anaaj ko payment maan lein, toh barter ki dikkat khatam ho jaayegi?
questions.hook: Anaaj se jootey mil gaye, lekin kuch mahine baad bacha hua 'paisa' sad gaya.

points.point: Commodity money ki intrinsic value hoti hai, yaani payment ke alawa bhi us cheez ka apna use aur value hota hai.
Community mein widely accepted aur doosre uses wali commodity barter se zyada aasani se payment ban sakti hai.
Metallic coins common hone se pehle commodity money medium bana aur double coincidence ki zaroorat ghati.
Commodity money mein quality-uniformity, divisibility, perishability, transport aur standardization ki dikkatein reh sakti hain.

film.showing_moment: Accepted anaaj exchange ko chala deta hai, par storage mein wahi anaaj kharab hokar payment value kho deta hai.

game_stage.idea: Alag commodities ko payment medium banao aur storage, chhutte payment aur transport mein unki performance dekho.

questions.question: Sikke anaaj se behtar the, toh phir kagaz ke note kyun aaye?
questions.hook: Chhota sauda coins se aasaan hai, lekin bade saude ke liye sikko ka bhaari sandook chahiye.

points.point: Metallic money gold, silver, copper, bronze ya electrum se banta tha; value metal aur baad mein minting authority se judi.
Durability, portability, divisibility, intrinsic value, standardization aur acceptance ne metallic money se trade zyada reliable banaya.
Early metal exchange Mesopotamia-Egypt mein tha, jabki pehle standardized coins ka credit aam taur par Lydia ko milta hai.
Limited supply, bhaari transport, theft, ghisawat aur debasement ne large-scale expansion roki aur paper money ki taraf dhakela.
Gold-backed note ki value kagaz mein nahi, fixed quantity gold mein redeem karne ke issuer ke promise mein thi.
Central bank gold reserve rakhta, notes issue karta aur redemption deta; gold backing ki requirement note issue ko constrain karti thi.

film.showing_moment: Gold vault mein reh jaata hai aur uske badle redeemable paper note bazaar mein chalne lagta hai.

game_stage.idea: Gold reserve badhao-ghatao aur fixed backing rule ke andar issue ho sakne wale notes ki quantity badalte dekho.

questions.question: Aaj ka note gold mein badalta nahi, phir bhi sab use kyun lete hain?
questions.hook: ₹500 ke kagaz ki material value bahut kam hai, par usse ₹500 ka sauda ho jaata hai.

points.point: Fiat money ki monetary value material ki intrinsic value ke bajay government authority aur public trust par tikti hai.
Fiat paper ya digital form mein ho sakta hai aur gold-silver redemption se backed hona zaroori nahi.
State-central bank framework fiat issue ko control karta hai; supply flexible hoti hai, par monetary policy aur public confidence maayne rakhte hain.
Legal tender kanoon se recognised debt-settlement status hai; fiat value ka basis hai, isliye dono terms ko universal synonyms mat samjho.
El Salvador ka Bitcoin case non-fiat legal tender ka exception samjhata hai; 2025 reforms ke baad private acceptance voluntary hui.

film.showing_moment: Note ki gold-redemption line hat jaati hai, par authority aur trust ke sahare payment network chalta rehta hai.

game_stage.idea: Value-backing aur legal-status ke do alag switches set karo; Bitcoin aur fiat ke cases sahi zones mein jaakar payment rules badlein.

questions.question: ₹100 ka special coin hazaaron mein bik sakta hai, par payment mein kitne ka chalega?
questions.hook: Collector ek coin ke liye ₹3,000 deta hai, lekin us par denomination ₹100 likhi hai.

points.point: Commemorative coin ka fiat/legal-tender status uske issue rules se dekho; circulation issues ordinary coins ki tarah use hote hain.
Proof ya UNC collector sets roz ke circulation mein kam aate hain; ₹100 legal-tender coin ki payment value ₹100 aur collector value kaafi zyada ho sakti hai.
Cheque aur credit card payment tools hain, apne aap fiat currency ya compulsory legal tender nahi.
Valid genuine ₹10, ₹20, ₹50, ₹100, ₹200 aur ₹500 banknotes unlimited legal tender ke examples hain; RBI Act, 1934 iska kanooni framework deta hai.
Coinage Act, 2011 ke limited legal tender mein compulsory acceptance prescribed amount tak hoti hai; usse aage acceptance voluntary hai.

film.showing_moment: Ek coin ke neeche collector price ₹3,000 dikhte hue bhi debt-settlement meter sirf ₹100 ghatta hai.

game_stage.idea: Debt chukane ke liye valid note, coin ya cheque chuno; denomination, legal limit aur voluntary acceptance ke hisaab se debt meter badle.

questions.question: Duniya ko zyada dollars chahiye the, toh America ka gold promise kyun toot gaya?
questions.hook: International trade dollar maang raha hai, lekin har naya dollar gold redemption par bharosa kam kar raha hai.

points.point: 1944 Bretton Woods mein US ne mainly foreign central banks ko US$35 ke badle ek troy ounce gold ka promise diya aur dollar reserve currency bana.
1960s ke war-welfare spending aur worldwide dollar expansion ne gold backing par pressure badhaya; France ne dollars ke badle gold maanga.
Triffin dilemma mein global trade ko dollar supply chahiye, lekin wahi extra supply gold convertibility par confidence kam karti hai.
15 August 1971 ko Richard Nixon ne dollar ki gold convertibility band kar di.

film.showing_moment: Dollars ka stack gold reserve se tez badhta hai aur redemption demand aate hi gold window band ho jaati hai.

game_stage.idea: Dollar supply badhakar trade ki demand poori karo; saath mein fixed gold reserve par redemption pressure aur confidence badalte dekho.

questions.question: Gold backing gayi, phir bhi duniya dollars kyun rakhti rahi?
questions.hook: Oil khareedne ke liye dollar chahiye, chahe dollar ke badle gold na mile.

points.point: Gold convertibility khatam hone ke baad dollar demand ke doosre sources ka sawaal mahatvapurn ho gaya.
1973 OPEC embargo mein oil prices lagbhag chaar guna hue; dollar-priced oil ne countries ki dollar demand ko support kiya.
1974 US-Saudi understanding mein dollar oil pricing aur oil revenues ka US Treasuries-financial markets mein investment mahatvapurn tha.
Is relationship mein US ki military protection, weapons supply aur Saudi security guarantees bhi shamil the.

film.showing_moment: Oil buyer ke dollars Saudi revenue ban kar US Treasury investments ki taraf lautte hain.

game_stage.idea: Oil buyer, Saudi oil revenue aur US financial market ko jodo; sahi route par dollar demand aur revenue recycling chal pade.

questions.question: Aaj ka rupee kabhi chandi ka sikka tha—uski pehchaan ek jaisi kaise bani?
questions.hook: Alag ilaqon ke alag coins se ek common rupee tak pahunchna sirf naam badalne ka kaam nahi tha.

points.point: Rupiya Sanskrit Rupya, yaani wrought silver se juda hai; Sher Shah Suri ne lagbhag 1540 mein uniform, high-purity 178-grain yani kareeb 11.5-gram silver rupee diya.
Mughal era mein Akbar ne minting badhai aur emperor ke naam wale standardized-weight silver coins empire bhar mein bane.
Coin-metal mapping mein Mohur gold, Rupee silver aur Dam copper se juda tha.
1757–1835 mein East India Company ne pehle Mughal-style coinage chalayi aur Bombay, Calcutta, Madras Presidencies alag coins mint karti thi.
Currency Act, 1835 ne British India ke liye uniform design aur monarch portrait wala common rupee aur single legal-tender framework diya.
Paper Currency Act, 1861 se banknotes issue karne ka exclusive right British government ko mila.
Silver discoveries se prices girne ke baad Fowler Committee, 1898 ne rupee ko gold se link karne ki recommendation di aur gold exchange standard ki taraf badlaav hua.

film.showing_moment: Alag mints ke uneven coins ek standardized rupee design aur weight par align ho jaate hain.

game_stage.idea: Sher Shah, Mughals, Presidency coins, 1835, 1861 aur silver crisis ke milestones jodo; har sahi step par rupee ka roop badle.

questions.question: Ek rupee mein kabhi 16 annas the—100 paise aur digital rupee tak kya badla?
questions.hook: Naam rupee hi raha, lekin uski counting, symbols, exchange rate aur digital form badalte gaye.

points.point: RBI 1935 mein shuru hua aur usne 1938 se notes issue kiye; colonial note portraits ki chronology ko George VI wale RBI issues se alag pehchaano.
Independence ke baad imperial symbols ki jagah Ashoka Lion Capital aaya, par British monetary system se links kuch samay rahe.
1955 amendment ke baad 1957 decimalization mein 1 rupee = 16 annas = 64 old paise = 192 pies ki jagah 100 naye paise hue.
1971 ke global gold-convertibility break ko India ke fiat framework ki taraf gradual transition ke context mein dekho, ek single domestic switch ki tarah nahi.
1993 se managed market-determined exchange rate mein RBI mainly excessive volatility smooth karta hai, fixed rate maintain nahi.
2010 mein adopted ₹ symbol D. Udaya Kumar ne Devanagari aur Roman script ke elements se design kiya.
Digital rupee RBI ki rupee-denominated legal-tender digital currency hai; wholesale pilot November 2022 aur retail pilot December 2022 se shuru hokar expand hue.

film.showing_moment: Rupee ki timeline par 16-anna counting tootkar 100-paise grid banti hai aur aakhir mein digital form judta hai.

game_stage.idea: RBI, independent symbols, decimalization, managed float, ₹ symbol aur digital pilots ko sequence mein rakho; har milestone par currency display update ho.

questions.question: Tughlaq ne copper ko silver ke barabar kaha, toh bazaar ne maanna kyun chhod diya?
questions.hook: Royal order ne coin ka face value badha diya, lekin ghar-ghar nakli coins banne lage.

points.point: 1329–1330 CE mein military expenditure, silver shortage aur administration-trade ki money needs ke beech Tughlaq ne brass-copper token ko silver Tanka ke barabar declare kiya.
Silver Tanka ki intrinsic value ke muqable token ka face value royal order se tha; maksad silver dependence ghatakar money supply aur trade badhana tha.
Easy imitation, insecure minting aur weak enforcement se counterfeit coins badhe, public trust gira aur traders ne tokens lena chhod diya.
Token withdrawal ke baad copper ko silver se exchange karne ki ijazat ne royal treasury ko bhaari loss diya.
Tughlaq ke weakly secured tokens ke muqable modern fiat money state-central bank institutions, advanced security aur public credibility par tikta hai.
Silver se token, counterfeiting, trust collapse aur withdrawal ki chain batati hai ki successful currency ke liye trust aur effective regulation zaroori hain.

film.showing_moment: Nakli token supply badhte hi acceptance network bujhne lagta hai aur redemption se treasury ka silver ghatt jaata hai.

game_stage.idea: Mint security aur enforcement set karke token experiment chalao; counterfeit supply, acceptance aur treasury loss ka outcome dekho.

questions.question: Note ko roshni mein dekhne aur ungli se chhoone par alag clues kyun milte hain?
questions.hook: Ek hi note ko tilt, touch aur light ke saamne karne se alag features ubharte hain.

points.point: Raised printing, identification marks, bade numerals aur distinct sizes visually impaired users ko denomination pehchaanne mein madad karte hain.
₹1 note Government of India issue karti hai, Finance Secretary sign karte hain aur RBI circulation manage karta hai.
RBI ka Paisa Bolta Hai resource denominations ke note features pehchaanne mein support deta hai.
Reverse language panel ki 15 languages aur Hindi-English mila kar note par total 17 languages represent hoti hain.
Watermark, Bharat-RBI-denomination wala security thread, tilt par latent image aur light mein milta see-through register visual security checks hain.
Micro-lettering, higher denominations par optically variable ink, intaglio feel aur increasing-size number panels security design ke aur parts hain.
RBI ka free MANI app 1 January 2020 ko launch hua; Android-iOS par install hone ke baad offline aur 15 languages mein denomination identify karne mein madad karta hai.

film.showing_moment: Note ko light ke saamne laate hi see-through register ke do adhoore parts milkar denomination bana dete hain.

game_stage.idea: Light, tilt, magnify ya touch mode chuno; note par us mode se visible feature khule aur denomination-identification clues judte jaayein.

questions.question: Note par 'promise' likha hai—kya RBI mujhe gold ya interest dega?
questions.hook: ₹100 ka purana note aaj bhi ₹100 hi hai, chahe usse milne wala samaan kam ho gaya ho.

points.point: Promise clause note ki face value ki RBI guarantee dikhata hai; bearer woh hai jiske physical possession mein note hai.
Historical convertible systems mein promise gold-silver redemption se juda tha, jaise Bretton Woods dollar aur British monetary arrangements.
Modern note gold-silver weight ya inflation-adjusted purchasing power ki guarantee nahi deta; yeh zero-interest anonymous bearer liability hai.
Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881 ke Section 4 mein banknote aur currency note excluded hain, isliye promise clause ke bawajood currency legally promissory note nahi.

film.showing_moment: Note ka face-value meter ₹100 par fixed rehta hai, jabki uske saamne khareedi ja sakne wali basket chhoti ho jaati hai.

game_stage.idea: Face value, gold redemption, interest aur inflation protection ke claim-tokens guarantee gate par rakho; valid claim hi note ke saath attach ho.

questions.question: ₹2,000 note wapas bulana aur ₹1,000 note band karna ek hi baat kyun nahi?
questions.hook: Dono baar note bank tak gaya, par sirf ek case mein uska legal-tender status hata.

points.point: Demonetisation currency ka legal-tender status hatana hai, jisse woh ordinary transactions ke liye valid nahi rehti.
India ke major demonetisations 1946, 1978 aur 2016 mein hue; 8 November 2016 ki announcement se existing ₹500 aur ₹1,000 notes ka status midnight se hata.
2023 mein ₹2,000 notes ka circulation withdrawal demonetisation nahi tha, kyunki unka legal-tender status bana raha.
₹2,000 note November 2016 mein liquidity jaldi restore karne aaya, printing 2018–19 mein ruki aur May 2023 withdrawal ke baad deposit-exchange process chala.

film.showing_moment: Do notes circulation se nikalte hain, par legal-tender light sirf demonetised note ki bujhti hai.

game_stage.idea: Har policy case mein circulation aur legal-tender ke alag controls chuno; dekho note ka payment-status badalta hai ya sirf bank ki taraf flow.

questions.question: Do sikko par same value likhi ho, toh log zyada silver wala kyun chhupa lete hain?
questions.hook: Bazaar mein ghatiya coin ghoom raha hai, jabki achha coin ghar ki tijori mein pada hai.

points.point: Gresham's Law mein fixed same face value par bad money circulation se good money ko displace karta hai.
Iske liye dono currencies legal tender, official exchange value fixed, ek ki intrinsic value undervalued aur spending ka choice available hona chahiye.
Log higher-intrinsic-value coin hoard ya melt karte hain aur lower-intrinsic-value coin payment mein kharch karte hain.
16th-century England mein Henry VIII ke debased silver coins ke saath equal face value wale purane purer coins hoard hone lage.

film.showing_moment: Har payment round mein low-silver coin bazaar mein laut-ta hai aur pure-silver coin tijori mein jama hota jaata hai.

game_stage.idea: Same face value wale do coins mein spend aur save ka choice karo; kai rounds ke baad circulation ka composition dekho.

questions.question: UPI ya cheque se payment mein note nahi jaata—phir paisa kya move hota hai?
questions.hook: Cash drawer nahi khulta, lekin ek account ghatta aur doosra badhta hai.

points.point: Bank money deposits ke roop mein hota hai aur modern money supply ka sabse bada hissa banata hai.
Cheque, UPI, debit card, NEFT aur RTGS deposit money transfer karne ke channels hain, deposit se alag naya paisa nahi.
NIA, 1881 transferable aur enforceable written payment promises-orders ka framework deta hai; ismein promissory note, bill of exchange aur cheque cover hote hain.
Promissory note mein maker payee ko fixed amount dene ka written promise karta hai, jaise Rahul ko 1 January ko ₹50,000 dena.
Bill of exchange mein drawer drawee ko payee ko payment ka order deta hai, jaise wholesaler ka retailer ko 90 din baad ₹1 lakh dene ka order.
Cheque bank par drawn, demand par payable special bill hai; drawer account holder, drawee bank aur receiver payee hota hai.

film.showing_moment: Payment instruction bank tak pahunchte hi payer ka deposit balance ghatta aur payee ka badhta hai.

game_stage.idea: Maker-payee ya drawer-drawee-payee ke roles jodkar instrument banao; sahi instruction se payment route activate ho.

questions.question: Cheque bounce ho sakta hai, toh demand draft par zyada bharosa kyun hota hai?
questions.hook: Dono papers payment ke liye hain, par ek mein funds pehle hi bank ko mil chuke hain.

points.point: Section 138 mein insufficient-funds jaise qualifying dishonour, statutory demand notice aur prescribed time mein non-payment ki conditions par cheque bounce criminal offence ban sakta hai.
Demand draft prepaid bank-issued instrument hai; customer pehle funds deta hai, isliye bank payment ki zimmedari leta hai.
Overdraft approved short-term credit hai jisme balance se zyada withdrawal allowed hota hai; eligible PMJDY holders ko bhi facility mil sakti hai.
MICR ka full form Magnetic Ink Character Recognition hai; iron-oxide ink ka 9-digit code machines ko cheques sort-clear karne mein madad deta hai.
11-character alphanumeric IFSC electronic-payment branch identify karta hai aur NEFT, RTGS, IMPS mein correct routing mein madad karta hai.

film.showing_moment: Cheque ka funds-check fail hota hai, jabki prepaid draft ka payment pehle se funded route par aage badhta hai.

game_stage.idea: Payment ko cheque, draft ya approved overdraft se route karo; available funds aur sahi MICR-IFSC ke hisaab se clearance chale ya ruke.

questions.question: UPI app par PIN daalte hi bank aur RBI ke beech kya hota hai?
questions.hook: Screen par success ek second mein dikhta hai, par peeche kai institutions kaam karte hain.

points.point: Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007 ke under RBI payment-settlement systems ka apex regulator hai.
RBI aur IBA ki 2008 initiative NPCI not-for-profit retail payment infrastructure chalata hai; customer deposits NPCI mein nahi, banks mein rehte hain.
Commercial, payment aur small finance banks ke saath apps, gateways aur merchants customer-facing layer banate hain.
UPI mein PIN-authorised request app se NPCI switch aur banks tak jaati hai; funds verification-confirmation ke baad interbank settlement RBI infrastructure se hota hai.
BHIM-UPI ke Prelims case mein UPI-enabled account ko transfer wala statement sahi hai; chip-PIN ke four-factor authentication wala claim galat hai.

film.showing_moment: Ek payment request app se NPCI switch par jaakar payer-payee banks ke beech route hoti hai.

game_stage.idea: App, NPCI, dono banks aur RBI ko sahi roles mein connect karo; NPCI ko deposit-holder banaoge toh payment route fail ho.

questions.question: Bijli ka bill apne aap kat sakta hai, par har baar PIN dabana kyun zaroori nahi?
questions.hook: Chai ki payment tum bhejte ho, lekin authorised monthly bill ki request merchant shuru kar sakta hai.

points.point: Push payment payer khud initiate karta hai, jaise friend ya chai seller ko paisa bhejna.
Authorised recurring pull mein pehle diye mandate ke rules ke andar biller payment initiate karta hai; bina authorisation arbitrary debit allowed nahi.
August 2024 delegated UPI feature mein primary user secondary user ko apne bank account se set limit tak spend karne ki permission de sakta hai.

film.showing_moment: Pre-approved mandate ka monthly trigger aate hi payment chalti hai, jabki limit se bahar request ruk jaati hai.

game_stage.idea: Mandate aur delegated spending limit set karo; bill ya secondary-user purchase limit ke andar ho toh payment chale, warna block ho.

questions.question: Transfer abhi karna ho, toh NEFT, RTGS aur IMPS mein kya farq padega?
questions.hook: Teen services 24×7 hain, phir bhi settlement ka tareeka aur suitable transaction alag hai.

points.point: NEFT 24×7 half-hourly batches mein ordinary bank transfers settle karta hai; charges ko customer-channel rules ke saath padho, blanket free claim ki tarah nahi.
NEFT ki bank-channel limits alag ho sakti hain; ₹5 lakh ko system-wide upper limit mat samjho.
RBI-operated RTGS 24×7 high-value transfers ko individually real time mein settle karta hai; inward free aur outward charges prescribed slabs mein up to ₹50 ho sakte hain.
IMPS mobile-internet banking se round-the-clock immediate transfer deta hai; listed transaction range ₹1 se ₹5 lakh tak hai.
RTGS-NEFT ke Prelims case mein sirf instantaneous RTGS versus batch NEFT wala statement sahi hai; RTGS inward charge aur restricted hours wale claims galat hain.

film.showing_moment: NEFT requests batch clock tak jama hoti hain, jabki RTGS ki request alag se turant settlement line paar karti hai.

game_stage.idea: Amount, urgency aur bank rules dekhkar transfer route chuno; batch clock, individual settlement aur applicable fee screen par badlein.

questions.question: Smartphone na ho, phir bhi Aadhaar se banking aur ek jagah bill payment kaise ho sakti hai?
questions.hook: Gaon ka Bank Mitra biometric se banking karata hai, jabki alag companies ke bills ek platform se bhar jaate hain.

points.point: AEPS Aadhaar-biometric authentication aur Bank Mitras ke through banking access deta hai, jo financial inclusion aur DBT access mein madad karta hai.
BBPS electricity, mobile, gas aur insurance jaise bills ke liye interoperable platform hai; AEPS aur BBPS NPCI ecosystem ka hissa hain.
NPCI ne 2012 mein RuPay, yaani Rupee plus Payment, domestic card-payment network launch kiya; global networks ke alternative aur lower-fee positioning ko samjho.
RuPay debit, credit aur prepaid forms mein hai; PMJDY debit-card access aur RuPay credit-card-UPI linking iske important uses hain.
NPCI ke Prelims case mein financial inclusion promote karna aur RuPay launch karna dono statements sahi hain.

film.showing_moment: Bank Mitra par biometric authentication successful hote hi customer ka banking access khul jaata hai.

game_stage.idea: Biometric banking, electricity bill aur card purchase ko AEPS, BBPS aur RuPay par bhejo; sahi infrastructure se service complete ho.

questions.question: Government ka ₹1,000 voucher vaccine par chale, shopping par kyun nahi?
questions.hook: Mobile par value aayi hai, par na cash nikal sakte ho aur na use kisi aur cheez par uda sakte ho.

points.point: 2021 ka NPCI e-RUPI UPI platform par bana prepaid cashless SMS-QR electronic voucher hai.
e-RUPI person-specific aur purpose-specific coupon hai, payment app, bank transfer ya digital currency nahi.
₹1,000 vaccination voucher intended beneficiary authorized centre par vaccine ke liye redeem karta hai; cash withdrawal ya unrelated shopping allowed nahi.

film.showing_moment: Wahi QR shopping counter par reject hota hai aur authorized vaccination centre par redeem ho jaata hai.

game_stage.idea: Beneficiary aur purpose match karke voucher centre tak pahunchao; galat person ya service par redemption gate band rahe.

questions.question: Card se ₹1,000 ki sale hui, toh merchant ko poore ₹1,000 kyun nahi milte?
questions.hook: Customer ne poora bill diya, phir bhi merchant settlement mein fee kat gayi.

points.point: MDR card transaction accept karne par merchant ka acquirer bank ko diya charge hai; direct payer merchant hai, customer nahi.
MDR acquiring bank, issuing bank, card network aur applicable payment gateway-service provider ke beech share hota hai.
MDR ke Prelims case mein merchant par bank ka card-acceptance charge wala option C sahi hai; incentive ya cashback wale options nahi.

film.showing_moment: Sale amount se MDR ka chhota hissa alag hokar payment-chain participants mein split ho jaata hai.

game_stage.idea: Merchant settlement aur fee-sharing chain banao; sahi recipients jodne par gross sale se net settlement nikle.

questions.question: UPI jitni aasani se foreign payment karni ho, toh har desh se alag link banana padega?
questions.hook: Paanch deshon ko aapas mein jodne ke liye bahut bilateral links chahiye, par ek common connector kaam aasaan kar sakta hai.

points.point: BIS Innovation Hub-led Project Nexus alag countries ke fast payment systems ko connect karne ki multilateral initiative hai.
Maksad international transfers ko domestic instant payment jitna aasaan banana hai; India ka UPI founding participating systems mein hai.
Traditional cross-border transfer mein multiple correspondent banks fees aur delay badha sakte hain.
Nexus standardized common connection deta hai, jisse har country pair ke liye separate payment link banana zaroori nahi rehta.

film.showing_moment: Countries ke beech uljhe bilateral links ek standardized Nexus connector ke around simplify ho jaate hain.

game_stage.idea: Naye country payment systems common connector se jodo; har addition par usable cross-border routes badhein bina har pair ka naya link banaye.

questions.question: Note polymer ka bana dein, toh kya woh bas aam plastic ka tukda hoga?
questions.hook: Roz mudne aur bheegne wala note agar zyada chale, toh replacement ka kharcha bhi bach sakta hai.

points.point: Polymer banknote traditional cotton substrate ki jagah security-grade BOPP aur embedded security features se banta hai, ordinary plastic se nahi.
2013 mein ₹10 polymer field trial approve hua; ₹10-₹20 jaise small notes ka proposal aur paper ke saath coexistence ko confirmed nationwide rollout mat samjho.
Polymer ka aim longer life, counterfeit resistance aur lower replacement cost hai; lifespan up to chaar guna ho sakta hai.
Australia ne 1988 mein polymer banknote introduce kiya aur 50 se zyada countries polymer notes use karti hain.

film.showing_moment: Repeated handling cycles mein cotton note replacement line tak pahunchta hai, jabki polymer note aur cycles survive karta hai.

game_stage.idea: Handling cycles badhao aur cotton-polymer notes ki surviving quantity aur replacement cost compare karo.

questions.question: Crypto bhi screen par number hai—phir woh digital rupee ya UPI balance jaisa kyun nahi?
questions.hook: Teen digital screens dikhne mein similar hain, par issuer, ownership record aur legal status alag hain.

points.point: Cryptocurrency blockchain par created-stored private digital asset hai; India mein na RBI-issued hai aur na legal tender.
Distributed ledger ownership records ko network par maintain karta hai, central bank-account ledger ke bina bhi.
2007–08 crisis ke baad fiat-banking par distrust aur transaction fees-interoperability ki complaints kuch crypto supporters ki motivations bani, crypto value ki guarantee nahi.

Public permissionless blockchain ke Prelims case mein inspectable non-single-user-controlled ledger aur permissionless applications sahi hain; blockchain ko crypto-only kehna galat hai, isliye answer 1 aur 3 hai.
Digital rupee RBI currency hai, UPI bank deposits ka payment channel hai aur crypto private digital asset hai.

film.showing_moment: Ek central ledger ki jagah transaction record ki matching copies distributed network ke nodes par update hoti hain.

game_stage.idea: Issuer, ledger aur legal-status parts se digital rupee, UPI deposit payment aur crypto ke profiles banao; sahi profile par ownership-record animation chale.

questions.question: RBI total paisa ginta hai, toh cash aur bank balance ko ek hi number mein kyun nahi jod deta?
questions.hook: Bank ki RBI reserve balance aur tumhari pocket ka cash dono rupees hain, par dono public spending money nahi.

points.point: Money supply kisi given time par economy mein spending, saving aur payments ke liye available money ka stock hai.
RBI M0 aur M1–M4 jaise measures alag components ke liye use karta hai; M3 key broad-money indicator hai, M4 broadest hai.
Households, businesses, banks aur RBI ke beech money flow hota rehta hai, par money supply ek time-point ka stock hai.
M0 reserve ya high-powered money hai, jo RBI-created monetary base ko capture karta hai.
M0 = currency in circulation + other deposits with RBI + bankers' deposits with RBI, jisme CRR balances bhi aate hain.
Reserve base banking-system lending aur deposit expansion ko support karta hai; expansion automatic ya unlimited nahi hota.

film.showing_moment: RBI base ke teen components assemble hote hain aur banking lending-deposit cycle se public deposits ka layer expand hota hai.

game_stage.idea: Currency, RBI other deposits aur bank reserves se M0 banao; public deposit ko galti se base mein jodne par double-count warning aaye.

questions.question: Pocket ka cash, savings account aur FD—RBI inhe alag baskets mein kyun rakhta hai?
questions.hook: FD bhi tumhara paisa hai, lekin chai ka payment cash ya demand deposit jitni seedhi tarah nahi hota.

points.point: M1 narrow money = public ke paas currency + demand deposits + other deposits with RBI; iske components everyday use ke liye highly liquid hain.
M2 = M1 + Post Office Savings Banks ke savings deposits; NSC jaise instruments is addition mein nahi aate.
M3 broad money = M1 + banks ke time deposits, jisme fixed aur recurring deposits shamil hain; reported money-supply growth aam taur par M3 hoti hai.
RBI M3 ko inflationary pressure, liquidity, credit growth aur monetary-policy effectiveness samajhne ke liye track karta hai.
M4 broadest measure = M3 + Post Office Savings Banks ke all deposits, NSC ko chhodkar.
NSC long-term savings instrument hai, readily spendable money nahi; isliye M4 mein count nahi hota.
M0 ki currency in circulation aur M1 ki public currency alag hain; M2 aur M3 bhi M1 se nikli alag branches hain, seedhi M1–M2–M3 nesting nahi.

film.showing_moment: M1 basket se do branches nikalti hain—post-office savings jodne par M2 aur bank time deposits jodne par M3; M3 mein eligible post-office deposits se M4 banta hai.

game_stage.idea: Cash, demand deposits, FD, post-office deposits aur NSC tokens se aggregates banao; sahi formula par total update ho aur excluded instrument par gate band rahe.
